item.title: Gujo Hachiman: A Historic Water Town of Clear Streams — Guide
item.description: Gujo Hachiman is a historic castle town in central Gifu famous for its exceptionally clear water, with canals, springs and streams threaded through the old streets, small waterways running beside houses, and a culture built around treasuring and using the pure water in daily life. Above the town sits a small reconstructed mountain castle with valley views, while the streets below are lined with traditional houses, sweet shops and workshops, and the town is especially renowned for the Gujo Odori, a lively folk dance held over many summer nights.
